name: Wrenfield House
summary: A detached three-storey family house of about 380 m², furnished in Blender: open-plan kitchen-diner, living room, study and snug on the ground floor, four bedrooms with two en-suites and the family bathroom on the first, and a loft room with its own shower room above. Every internal door works, and both stair flights are walkable.
